answer: Mirror-Inlet Plume Toll: coordination intents enter a shared inlet that samples a pending plume and derives a challenge nonce from it. Each intent must attach a mirror commitment—hash of local state plus nonce. The inlet estimates mutual dependence among commitments; dependent clusters of size k pay a per-intent toll base×(1+log2 k) and wait one plume epoch. Sybil cost scales as k log k plus timing loss; splitting forfeits synchronized execution.
